A hot air balloon doesn't rise just because the flame is lit.

Fill it with hot air while the basket is still tied to the ground and loaded with sandbags, and it goes nowhere. You have to untie the ropes first. Then you clear the sandbags. Only then does the heat actually take you up.

A human being works the same way. You can't think positive your way past baggage that's still physically holding you down — the ties have to go, one at a time, before the rising even starts.
